title: Stacked sample cards into an editor zoom tour
summary: Two stacked cards show finished sample clips, a feed post proves reach with a climbing view count, then the camera dives through an editor: typed prompts, a step list, a tilted gallery, layer swaps. Mark tile, URL and offer close it.
use_when: A vertical promo for a creative or video tool that has finished outputs worth showing first
VO-led social ad (about 40 s) that walks three ways to use the product
The product has a canvas plus timeline UI that reads well in punch-ins
Closing on an integration: your mark plus a partner mark side by side

look.type_style: UI type is the product's own small grotesk; close lines medium-weight rounded grotesk, sentence case, normal tracking, about 3 % of frame height, centred, black on the gradient

sfx.event: feature pills pop around the phone (row 10)
cursor clicks the button, send and menu items (rows 11, 13, 15)
whip to the properties panel and back (rows 13, 14)
mark tile lands on a hard cut (rows 7, 18)

params.brand: any brand.json: warm gradient colours, accent for buttons, display font for the close lines
params.content.samples: 3-4 short finished clips for the two stacked cards in the hook
params.content.covers: about 20 square thumbnails for the growing wall
params.content.post: a vertical clip of the product in use, plus a view figure from and to
params.content.editorClips: screen recordings: canvas, prompt typing, step list, gallery, layer swap, timeline
params.content.prompts: two prompt lines: one about 7 words, one about 5 words
params.content.screenshots: 2 phone screenshots for the layer swap
params.content.partnerMark: optional second mark for the integration pair
params.voiceOver: VO file and words.json; rows stretch to its sentence ends

notes: Rows follow the VO: each sentence gets one row or a pair. Only 5 hard cuts in 42 s (1 of 5 within 2 fr of a beat); most changes are continuous camera moves inside screen recordings. Speeds are from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s) and motion.json, not from 30 fps strips; spring names are suggestions (overshoot not measurable). SFX planned by the glue rule, not measured: the reference has VO plus music and no SFX can be told apart. Proposed terms (not in the vocabulary): stacked-sample-cards, partner-tile-pair, gradient-interlude.
